title: Station Meridian Rising Revisited
author: Theo Blackwood
blurb: Zephyrine Eriksen, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
